text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock E just because it was far above my average cost may have cut short further gains; I’ll judge each holding by its outlook and portfolio role, not my purchase price.","Realizing gains feels rewarding, but that feeling shouldn’t drive trades. I’ll trim only when my allocation or investment rationale calls for it.","I made no trades through several market swings, and the account remained broadly resilient. I’ll stay patient, avoid reacting to short-term moves, and trade deliberately."]}
